name: Future Puerto Rican Stones
description: The Future Puerto Rican Stones were founded in 1970 by a youth known as "Stoney" and his four brothers in Chicago's Lake View neighborhood, initially operating out of Halsted and Newport. The gang grew from direct ties to the Puerto Rican Stones, sharing the same rivalries with groups such as the Simon City Royals, Spanish Cobras, and Assyrian Eagles. By 1975 they relocated to Albany Park, expanding significantly through the 1980s and gaining recognition as a distinct People Nation entity.
